zh.d:
本版桌面端的重头是两件事：换机不再是重头再来（备份与恢复），以及内置网络搜索让智能体能回答「现在」的问题。另有一批长会话体验与稳定性的修复。

【新增】
· 系统设置新增备份与恢复：按类别勾选要带走的数据导出归档；恢复按类别合并，只含会话的归档不会动目标机器的模型配置。备份文件路径留在界面上可一键打开；附件改为默认不打入备份
· 内置网络搜索：智谱、豆包、阿里云、腾讯元器四个提供方开箱即用，不填 Key 走内置通道；支持自定义提供方、编辑端点与一键连通性测试；智谱可选档位，无链接的搜索结果不再被丢弃
· 上下文窗口默认 1M；用量过 80% 工具栏直接提醒该压缩了；供应商以「放不下」拒绝时自动恢复并说明；压缩失败的原因说人话（13 种语言）
· 「在等你」和「还在干活」分开了：因工具确认或向用户提问而停下的会话，侧边栏和会话内都有警示色标记，不用逐个打开找
· 会话里的 Mermaid 图可平移缩放（滚轮仍留给页面滚动）；会话与预览面板支持 WaveDrom 时序图
· 会话完成的通知带上会话名；文件树新增「全部折叠」
· 外观设置按区域（全局 / 会话 / Markdown / 代码）选择字体族与字重，候选来自系统字体，不设则继承全局
· 媒体：消息在要图、要视频时自动切到生成模式，不再把「画一只猫」交给文本模型；欢迎页生成后的追问也留在生成模式

【优化改进】
· 读图先走本机 OCR，读不动再落视觉模型；本机 OCR 不再自称「精确转写」
· 预览面板里离屏的标签页恢复右键菜单，新增标签页操作与最大化切换
· 「新建团队」对话框可以拖开了，不再挡着正在填的内容
· 团队成员的供应商配额用尽时，通知会说明是谁

【修复】
· 一轮对话结束后输入框一直转圈「处理中」，只有切走再切回才消
· 打字快时连按回车，斜杠命令被当普通消息原样发出
· Markdown 表头与表体行错位
· WebUI 桥接 WebSocket 持续失败时形成重连风暴：频率跟着消息量走、退避被重置、已停掉的连接被悄悄复活
· 空白会话标题无法点击重命名
· 没选模型时被静默替选一个，而不是报出来
· 发送框删掉一段重复的规则块；草稿按钮尺寸与输入框对齐
· 设置页助手、智能体、技能卡片的边框一直全透明，静止时看不出轮廓；现与专家市场卡片一致，静止即有边框
· Agnes 图片：引用图移入 extra_body 按要求格式发送；agnes-ai.cn 域名被识别、视频模式按实际能力匹配；Agnes 3.0 Flash 会读图了
· 截断工具调用的重试提示已本地化到 13 种语言
· 搜索代理查询失败、配置读取失败不再中断整个 MCP 启动
· 长回复的输出预算先压到上下文窗口能容纳的上限，不再触发上游拒绝

本版补齐资源分发的最后几个缺口，并把 license 与部署环境绑得更紧。以下改进运行在企业服务端，更新服务端后生效。

【新增】
· 资源包：技能 / MCP 包文件、数字员工 ZIP 上传、RAG 库、登录风险闸门与管理后台页面一并交付；MCP 注册表接受 zip 与 README，员工包能解开内层 skill.zip 直接绑定
· API 资产可对声明的端点做探测，并直接发布为 MCP 工具；配置集新增别名 / 作用域 / 启用开关，未启用的保险库不再进入展开
· license 收紧：离线 license 与客户请求绑定；未认证付费档位一律拒绝；校验器与签发方口径对齐；license 详情页显示部署指纹
· 平台集成：保存的端点可做 HTTP/TCP 探测；SMTP 启用后邀请邮件走企业自己的中继；租户可登记 IM 管道与外观 / 风险 / 市场配置
· 系统管理员可重置成员密码；改密码只吊销该成员自己的会话
· 管理后台：向量化运维与交接状态补齐，新增可观测性与治理页面

【修复】
· 飞书 SSO 令牌交换失败能看到对方返回的真实原因（密钥错误 / code 已消费 / 重定向不匹配），不再只显示「HTTP 400」
· 资源授权矩阵页不再循环重复请求有效授权；审批弹窗关不掉、侧边栏点击偶发失灵已修
· 客户端断开连接不再与未授权会话混为同一提示
· 团队下发的技能绑定 ID 并入成员技能列表；团队资源绑定值逐项校验

企业服务端与桌面客户端独立更新，需要获取对应版本请与我们联系。

en.d:
Two headline items this release: backup and restore — moving machines no longer means starting over — and built-in web search, so the agent can finally answer questions about "now". A batch of long-session fixes rides along.

[New]
· System settings gain backup and restore: pick categories (conversations, model configuration, skills…), write an archive, and restore merges per category — a conversations-only archive cannot touch the target machine's model configuration. The finished file's path stays on screen with a reveal button; attachments now opt in instead of defaulting in
· Built-in web search: Zhipu, Doubao, Aliyun and Tencent WSA work out of the box — no key needed, the built-in channel covers it — plus a custom provider option, editable endpoints and a one-click connectivity test. Zhipu's tier is selectable and link-less results are no longer dropped
· The context window defaults to 1M; past 80% the toolbar tells you to compact; a provider rejecting the prompt as too long recovers automatically with an explanation; failed compactions say what went wrong, in all 13 languages
· "Waiting for you" is told apart from "still working": conversations paused on a tool confirmation or a question carry a warning-toned marker in the sidebar and in place
· Mermaid diagrams in chat pan and zoom (the wheel stays with page scrolling); WaveDrom timing diagrams render in chat and the preview panel
· Turn-completed notifications name the conversation; the file tree gains Collapse All
· Appearance takes a font family and weight per region (global / chat / Markdown / code), enumerated from system fonts, inheriting the global when unset
· Media: a message asking for a picture or video switches to generation mode automatically — "draw me a cat" no longer goes to a text model — and follow-ups stay in generation mode

[Improved]
· Reading an image tries on-device OCR first, falling back to the vision model; local OCR no longer calls itself an exact transcription
· Tabs scrolled off-screen in the preview panel get their context menu back, plus tab actions and a maximize toggle
· The New Team dialog can be dragged aside, off whatever you were filling in
· A teammate's exhausted provider quota is reported by name

[Fixed]
· The send box kept its "processing" spinner after a turn ended until you switched conversations and back
· Pressing Enter quickly while typing fast sent the raw "/command" as an ordinary message
· Markdown table headers did not line up with their body rows
· The WebUI bridge websocket formed a reconnect storm under repeated failures — the rate tracked emissions, backoff reset on open, and killed connections were resurrected
· A blank conversation title was not clickable to rename
· With no model picked, one was silently chosen for you instead of the gap being reported
· A duplicated rule block in the send box is gone; the draft button matches the composer
· Assistant, agent and skill cards in settings had fully transparent borders; they now match the expert marketplace cards, visible at rest
· Agnes image: reference images move into extra_body in the requested shape; the agnes-ai.cn host is recognised and its video mode matched; Agnes 3.0 Flash reads images with its own eyes
· The truncated-tool-call retry notice is localized to all 13 languages
· A failed search-broker lookup or config read no longer aborts the whole MCP bootstrap
· An over-long reply is capped to what the context window can hold before it is sent

This release closes the last gaps in resource distribution and binds licences more tightly. Everything below runs on the enterprise server and takes effect once that server is updated.

[New]
· Resource packs: skill / MCP pack files, employee ZIP upload, RAG libraries, login risk gating and the admin console SPA ship together; the MCP registry accepts zip and READMEs, and an employee pack unpacks an inner skill.zip for direct binding
· API assets can probe their declared endpoints and be published straight as MCP tools; config sets gain alias / scope / enabled, keeping unused vaults out of expansion
· Licences tighten: offline licences bind to the customer's request; unauthenticated paid tiers fail closed; the verifier aligns with the provisioner; the licence detail page shows the deployment fingerprint
· Platform integrations: saved endpoints get HTTP/TCP probes; with SMTP enabled, invite mail goes through the company's own relay; tenants can register IM pipelines and appearance / risk / marketplace configuration
· System administrators can reset a member's password; a password change revokes only that member's sessions
· Admin console: embedding operations and handoff statuses are finished, with new observability and governance surfaces

[Fixed]
· A failed Feishu SSO token exchange surfaces the provider's actual reason (bad secret / consumed code / redirect mismatch) instead of a bare "HTTP 400"
· The resource grant matrix page no longer refetches effective grants in a loop; the approval modal and sidebar clicks are fixed
· A client disconnecting is no longer reported as an unauthorized session
· Team-distributed skill bindings merge into the member's skill list; team resource bindings are validated

The enterprise server and the desktop client update independently; contact us for the matching server build.
